deepseek-api-key.description: A deepseek API key so the env-gated live test can drive dispatch run --no-dry-run through a real AgentMcpRunner (npx -y @adhd/agent-mcp) against deepseek-chat. Paid third-party model — the one legitimate live-test gate.
deepseek-api-key.how_to_provide: Export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (and AGENT_MCP_LIVE=1 to run the paid live assertion) in the executor environment.
